name: Recipe generation — ingredients to three recipes

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/generate-recipe. Body is the RecipeRequest from src/app/core/recipe-request.ts.

nodes.name: Validate request
nodes.notes: Checklist requirement: revalidate the frontend's input before the paid model is reached.

nodes.name: Reject invalid request
nodes.notes: Answers 400 with the concrete reasons instead of failing the run.

nodes.name: Resolve client IP and date
nodes.notes: Same logic as the quota lookup workflow. Broken IP detection falls back to the system-wide counter.

nodes.name: Read today's counters
nodes.notes: The /quota subtree is denied to clients by database rule; only this service account reads it.

nodes.name: Check quota
nodes.notes: Cost airbag before the model call: 3 per IP per day, 12 system-wide.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: $json.systemLimitReached ? "The daily limit for everyone is reached. Please try again tomorrow." : "You used all 3 recipe generations for today. Please try again tomorrow.", quota: { remaining: 0, limit: $json.limit, systemLimitReached: $json.systemLimitReached } }) }}

nodes.name: Reject over quota
nodes.notes: 429 with a message the user can act on, distinguishing the personal from the system-wide limit.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Cardinality rules are repeated in the prompt because the API only guarantees syntactically valid JSON.

nodes.name: Generate recipes
nodes.notes: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite: 15 requests per minute and 500 per day on the free tier, against 20 per day for the non-Lite models. Schema options are not passed through by this node, so JSON is requested in the prompt and verified afterwards.

nodes.name: Parse and verify recipes
nodes.notes: Enforces what the schema cannot: exactly three recipes, at most three missing ingredients, matching cuisine/diet/time, steps renumbered, assignedTo within the helper count, nutrition present. Throws otherwise, which reaches the error workflow.

nodes.name: Store recipes
nodes.notes: Runs once per recipe because the previous node emits three items. Firebase POST generates the key and returns it as body.name - that key becomes the recipe id.

nodes.name: Collect ids and raise counters
nodes.notes: Gathers the three generated Firebase keys and prepares the new quota counters.

nodes.name: Raise quota counters
nodes.notes: PATCH merges both counters in one call. Deliberately after the recipes are stored: a failed write must not consume quota.

nodes.name: Build response
nodes.notes: Returns the three recipes with their ids plus the remaining quota, matching GenerateRecipesResponse in src/app/core/recipe.ts.
